newsitem.title: USA: PacifiCare sees weak Q2 results.
newsitem.headline: PacifiCare sees weak Q2 results.

text.p: PacifiCare Health Systems Inc said Monday it expects its results for the second quarter will be below analysts' estimates.
The company said in a statement its earnings for the quarter, ended June 30, will be below the First Call consensus estimate of $1.16 a share.
In the comparable year-ago quarter the company had net income of $8.57 million, or $0.27 a share.

PacifiCare attributed the expected shortfall to substantially lower performance in a number of FHP International Co markets and disappointing results in California for the month of May. PacifiCare acquired FHP in February.
The company said it will be able to discuss more about the expected earnings shortfall later this week when it plans to hold an investor conference call.
